name: Charades Chaos Deck
shortDescription: Fast party charades with taboo hints, swipe controls, and team score tracking.

improvements.description: Added round selection (1-3 rounds), 100 cards with 4 taboo words each, per-word taboo card layout, buzzer button, auto team-switch on timer expiry, start/pause timer, help modal, and game-over winner screen.
Buzzer button now advances to the next card without scoring; deck updated to 100 single-word targets each with 4 contextually appropriate taboo words.

generation.notes: Selected from vote-and-category-analysis recommendation (Entertainment) and built as a social charades experience with keyboard/touch support.
